parameters.query:
UPDATE governance.hub_snapshots
SET is_active = false
WHERE snapshot_type = '{{$json.snapshot_type_sql}}'
  AND is_active = true;

INSERT INTO governance.hub_snapshots (
  snapshot_type, protocol, version, encoding, compression, payload_b64, payload_sha256, payload_size_bytes, created_by, source_repo, source_ref, is_active
) VALUES (
  '{{$json.snapshot_type_sql}}',
  '{{$json.protocol_sql}}',
  '{{$json.version_sql}}',
  '{{$json.encoding_sql}}',
  '{{$json.compression_sql}}',
  '{{$json.payload_b64_sql}}',
  '{{$json.payload_sha256_sql}}',
  {{Math.trunc($json.payload_size_bytes)}},
  '{{$json.created_by_sql}}',
  NULLIF('{{$json.source_repo_sql}}',''),
  NULLIF('{{$json.source_ref_sql}}',''),
  true
)
RETURNING snapshot_id::text, snapshot_type, is_active;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'stored', snapshot_id: ($json[0]?.snapshot_id || $json.snapshot_id || null), snapshot_type: ($json[0]?.snapshot_type || $json.snapshot_type || null), is_active: ($json[0]?.is_active ?? $json.is_active ?? true) } }}
